summary: This bill amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to require colleges and universities to report hate crime data disaggregated by subcategory based on the identity of the targeted individual or group, using FBI guidelines.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to require institutions of higher education to track and report hate crime data with more specificity. While it modifies reporting requirements for educational institutions, it does not directly impact spending levels on public schools, either positively or negatively.
